messages:
Carla R.: Quick status check for PM-2026-210 remediations. L3 asked for a snapshot; two items are overdue and one needs an owner confirmation. Please post one-line updates.

Carla R.: Action summary from PM-2026-210:
```
R1 - stabilize autoscale signal processing (owner: Tom H.) - due 2026-03-21
R2 - add API-level circuit-breaker for model routing (owner: Priya S.) - due 2026-03-19
R3 - alert for KV-store miss rate spike (owner: Leo G.) - due 2026-03-20
R4 - document postmortem learning in runbook (owner: unassigned) - due 2026-03-25
```

Tom H.: R1: PR up (runtime autoscaler) but performance bench failed yesterday (noisy infra). Re-running with isolated nodes. Link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/autoscale/pull/222. ETA: 2026-03-22 after rerun.

Priya S.: R2: Circuit-breaker rule implemented and staged; did a short canary. Need one more business-hour of traffic to feel safe. Marking "verifying".

SRE Bot: :warning: R1 is past due by 1 day. Owner: Tom H.

Leo G.: R3: Alert rule added but thresholds too sensitive on initial traffic. Tweaked to reduce noise; will watch for 24h. Moving to verifying.

Carla R.: Tom, can you post the rerun status by 18:00 UTC? If the infra rerun fails again we need a mitigation plan so L3 can close the loop.

Tom H.: Will do. If rerun flakes again I'll push a temporary backoff that reduces the autoscale aggressiveness until we get stable signals. That would be a short-term mitigation.

Carla R.: Ok noted. R4 is unassigned — any volunteers to convert the doc notes into a runbook section? 30-45m task.

Priya S.: I can take R4 after verification completes for R2. Could be done by 2026-03-24.

SRE Bot: :mega: Reminder: R1 is overdue. Escalation scheduled if no ETA update by 18:00 UTC.

Carla R.: Thanks Priya. Leo, please post a one-line verification result by 12:00 UTC so I can mark R3 in the digest.

Leo G.: Will do. Quick note: R3 noise was from canary traffic mislabelling, not infra. Fixed labeling rule.

Tom H.: Rerun started on isolated nodes. If green I'll merge and add a rollback snippet to the PR. ETA update: 2026-03-21 17:30 UTC.

Carla R.: If rerun fails again I will escalate to Eng leads. @Eng Lead: Nora please standby in case we need reassign.

Eng Lead: Nora: Acknowledged. If Tom still cannot land R1 by tonight we'll reassign mitigation tasks to platform squad.

Carla R.: Summary for L3: R2 verifying (Priya), R3 verifying (Leo) pending 12:00 UTC check, R1 overdue-in-progress (Tom) - rerun in progress; escalation if no merge by 18:00 UTC, R4 assigned to Priya after R2.

SRE Bot: :white_check_mark: Thread reminder cleared (R1 updated).

Tom H.: Rerun green. Merged and rolled to canary. Adding rollback plan and test notes to PM-2026-210 doc now.

Carla R.: Excellent — thanks Tom. I'll close R1 as resolved in the digest and include runbook follow-up for R4. If anyone needs help moving R4 forward ping me and I'll re-prioritize. :thumbsup:
